reference_config.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_dt00125_v1
reference_config.scope: New full-cycle passive P2 reference from rest after the failed P2/2.5ms attempt. Fixed 1.25ms steps on the same polyhedral domain and P1 fiber fields. Comparison against P1/2.5ms changes both element order and timestep; it does not isolate p-convergence or establish continuum truth. Frozen neural models remain unchanged.

reference_summary.positivity_scope: Source degree-6 quadrature points and all tetrahedral vertices, endpoint and generalized-alpha stress states; not a mathematical positivity guarantee between sample locations.

scope: Full cycle. Discretization sensitivity on one passive geometry/loading: P2 on 17625 tetrahedra versus P1 on 17625 and141000 tetrahedra. Different timesteps change BOTH temporal and spatial discretization. P2 is a comparison reference, not assumed continuum truth.
limitations: Not a three-level asymptotic convergence study.
No claim of continuum-calibrated neural intervals.
Does not modify frozen models or their held-out results.

native_norm_verification.scope: Independent native interpolation to common P2 space, then exact degree-4 UFL integration.

native_kinematics_verification.scope: Actual nonlinear P2-field determinant integration versus native UFL at fixed frames.
